Meals for Weight-loss: Ep 8 Honey Garlic Chicken 640 cals, 58g protein, 54 carbs, 12 fat per serving Makes 4 servings You can find all my recipes link in bio!  You would think this is unhealthy but its perfect for meal prep and its SO GOOD! Here is how I made it: 1. Add 1.5 cups jasmine rice and 2.25 cups water to a rice cooker and cook according to the rice cooker settings. 2. In a large bowl, combine 800 g chicken breast, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, 1 tbsp cornstarch, and 1 tsp black pepper. Mix until the chicken is evenly coated and let it marinate for 20-30 minutes. 3. Air fry the chicken at 400°F for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through, until cooked through and lightly caramelized. 4. Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 4 cloves minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Add 600 g broccoli florets and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes. Pour in 2-3 tbsp water, cover for 1 minute, then uncover and season with 1 tbsp soy sauce, ½ tsp black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Toss everything together for another 1-2 minutes, then set aside. 5. In the same wok, add 4 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp honey, 6 cloves minced garlic, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and ¾ cup water. Bring to a simmer. Mix 2 tsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water and stir it into the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens. Add the cooked chicken and toss until every piece is coated. 6. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. Now it’s time to enjoy! #healthyrecipes #mealprep #healthyfoodshare #amateurprochef #takeoutrecipes

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Chicken Alfredo garlic bread ✨🧄 This + a Caesar salad sooo good! Recipe is for two but can be used for one big longer French roll. Ingredients - 1 loaf French bread or Italian bread - 3 tbsp unsalted butter - 5 cloves garlic, minced - 2 boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 cup heavy cream - 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese - 1 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella cheese (1/4 for pasta sauce the rest for bread) - 2 tsp garlic powder  - 2 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp basil - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and black pepper to taste - Fresh parsley, chopped (for garnish) Garlic butter - 1 stick unsalted butter, softened  - 2 tbsp parsley, chopped - 1/4 cup Parmesan  - 2 tsp garlic paste - 1 tsp garlic powder - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions - Set to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. - Slice the loaf in half lengthwise. In a small bowl, mix softened butter, garlic paste, parsley, garlic powder, salt, pepper and stir until combined. - Brush evenly over both halves of the bread. Toast in the oven for 5–7 minutes until slightly golden. (Optional) - In a saucepan over medium high hear sear chicken breast on both sides for 5-8 minutes or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove from pan. - In the same pan, add butter, and minced garlic. Cook until fragrant about 1-2 minutes. Add heavy cream and Stir until smooth. - Add mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and stir until melted and creamy. - Season with garlic powder, oregano, basil, red pepper chili flakes, salt and pepper. - Spoon the Alfredo sauce evenly over each bread half. Sprinkle extra mozzarella on top. Add sliced chicken and more Alfredo sauce. - Return to the oven for 15-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. - Garnish with chopped parsley. - Slice and serve warm. • • • #Recipe #recipeideas #garlicbread #DinnerIdeas

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Taco Tuesday has never been easier! 🌮 Get the full recipe details below or at the link in our bio. ⤵️ Ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in ¾” inch pieces 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 3/4 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1 cup green enchilada sauce or tomatillo salsa, divided 1 can pinto beans, drained 2 tablespoons melted butter 8 6-inch flour tortillas 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese 1/2 cup sour cream Shredded lettuce and any other desired toppings Directions: Preheat oven to 375. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken pieces well with garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili powder and cumin. Add chicken to hot skillet and cook, undisturbed until browned and easily releases from the pan, 3-4 minutes. Add onion and stir chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, 3 more minutes. Add 2/3 cup salsa and beans and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat slightly and cook, stirring occasionally until slightly thickened and creamy, about 5 minutes. Brush sides and bottom of an 11 x 7 baking pan or baking dish with butter. Working with 1 tortilla at a time, use remaining butter to brush one side of each tortilla and place in dish. Place about 1 tablespoons of cheese in bottom of the tortilla and top with about 1/3 cup filling and a couple more tablespoons of cheese. Fold tortilla up like a taco and place it against the edge of the pan. Place a second buttered tortilla against the next one and top with cheese and filling. Fold in half and repeat with remaining tortillas, filling and cheese to fill the baking dish with side by side tacos. Top with any remaining cheese. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tops of each tortilla are golden brown and toasted and cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, stir together remaining salsa with sour cream until well combined. Top with lettuce just before serving and serve topped with sour cream sauce. ✨ Recipe Inspiration: @iramsfoodstory 🎥: Nicole @nicolesperfectbite #chicken #tacos #baking #dinner

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 1: Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken Mac & Cheese Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Hot sauce • Pickle juice • Buttermilk • PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning • Potato starch • Flour • Frying oil • Honey chipotle sauce • Butter • Evaporated milk • Whole milk • Heavy cream • Mustard • Cheddar • Gruyère • Mozzarella • Oaxaca • Monterey Jack • Pasta shells • Paprika • Ranch • Parsley Instructions 1. Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. Coat the chicken and fry until crispy and cooked through. Toss in honey chipotle sauce. 3. Melt butter, stir in flour and Cajun seasoning, then gradually add evaporated milk, whole milk and heavy cream. Once thickened, stir in hot sauce and mustard. 4. Melt in cheddar, Gruyère, mozzarella, Oaxaca and Monterey Jack. Fold in the cooked shells. 5. Add half the mac and cheese to a baking dish, layer with cheese, then add the rest. Top with cheddar and paprika and bake at 325°F until hot and bubbly. 6. Serve the mac and cheese topped with honey chipotle chicken, ranch and parsley. #chicken #cheese #chipotle #dinner #recipe

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

The Secret Behind Morocco's Success 🇲🇦 Morocco went from 79th in the FIFA rankings to another World Cup quarter-final in just over 15 years. So how did they pull it off? Back in 2009, Morocco decided to rebuild football from the ground up. They invested millions into a new national football center, scouted more than 15,000 kids across the country, and selected just 57 to join their academy. Almost all of them became professionals, with players like Youssef En-Nesyri and Azzedine Ounahi making it to Europe. At the same time, Morocco also built a huge scouting network to convince players with Moroccan roots, like Achraf Hakimi, Brahim Díaz and, more recently, Ayyoub Bouaddi, to represent the national team. And they haven't stopped. Morocco is building the Grand Stade Hassan II stadium for the 2030 World Cup and continues to invest millions into football across the country. Don't be surprised if, by the next World Cup, Morocco will win the whole thing. #soccer #football #WorldCup #Morocco #France

This was a freaking 1000/10 🤤✨ Apple Pie Pull Apart Bread 🍎🥧🍂 Ingredients: Apple Filling: * 3 apples, peeled and diced * 2 tbsp butter * ⅓ cup brown sugar * 1 tsp cinnamon * ¼ tsp nutmeg * 1 tsp vanilla * 1 tbsp lemon juice * 1 tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp water * Pinch of salt Bread * 2 cans refrigerated biscuits * 1 stick butter, melted * 1 cup white sugar * 1 tbsp cinnamon Instructions: 1. Make the apple filling: Cook diced apples with butter, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and salt for 6–8 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and stir it in. Cook 1–2 more minutes until thick. Stir in vanilla and let cool. 2. Make the cinnamon sugar: Mix the white sugar and cinnamon together. 3. Prepare the biscuits: Open each biscuit in half, creating two thinner pieces. 4. Build the layers: Dip each biscuit half in melted butter, then coat it in the cinnamon sugar. Place the pieces into a greased loaf pan, layering them with the apple filling between sections. 5. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 1 hour, or until the center is fully baked.       (The glaze on top is just 1 cup powdered sugar with 2-3 tbsp milk)    #easyrecipe #dessertrecipes #baking #fallrecipes #fallbaking

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

BUN BO HUE aka my favorite food EVER 🥢 #bunbohue #vietnamesefood #noodles #easyrecipe #asmr  Bun Bo Hue Broth - Flank steak - Parboiled beef bones - Lemongrass - Pineapple - Ginger - Daikon - Shallot - Yellow onion - Water - Salt - Chicken bouillon - Mushroom bouillon - Fish sauce - Shrimp paste - Saté Parboil the flank steak and beef bones for 5–10 minutes, then rinse well. Add to a large stock pot with slightly smashed lemongrass, pineapple, ginger, daikon, shallot, onion, and a few spoonfuls of salt. Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook for 1 hour, continuously skimming the scum from the top. Remove the flank steak and set aside to cool, then add the saté and simmer the broth for another 5 hours. Remove the onion, shallot, and ginger (I keep the daikon for my bowls) and season with chicken bouillon, mushroom bouillon, fish sauce, and shrimp paste. Taste and adjust to your preference. Saté - Shallot - Garlic - Lemongrass - Avocado oil - BBH seasoning - Red pepper flakes - Sugar - Shrimp paste - Fish sauce Sauté finely minced shallot, garlic, and lemongrass in avocado oil for about 5 minutes, until slightly golden and fragrant. Add a packet of BBH seasoning and red pepper flakes and sauté for another 2 minutes. Add half to the broth and reserve the other half for garnish. To the reserved saté, add a small ladle of broth, sugar, shrimp paste, and fish sauce, then sauté for another couple minutes. Bowl - Thick rice vermicelli - Cabbage - Bean sprouts - Sliced flank steak - Yellow onion - Green onion - Cilantro - Lime - Saté I like to prep all my toppings ahead of time and store them in glass containers for easy assembly throughout the week. Rinse and dry the cabbage and bean sprouts well, then store in a paper towel-lined container. Keep the sliced flank steak separate. For the noodles, boil for 10–15 minutes depending on thickness, then turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for another 10–15 minutes. Strain and rinse very well to remove excess starch, then let dry for about 15 minutes before assembling.

Crab Rangoon Filling  Ingredients 	•	9 oz imitation crab, finely chopped (if you don’t find this exact amount, just be sure to have equal amounts of crab and cream cheese)  	•	9 oz cream cheese, softened 	•	1 tbsp soy sauce 	•	4 cloves garlic, grated 	•	1 tsp ginger paste 	•	1 tbsp sugar 	•	1 tsp sesame oil 	•	1 tsp MSG 	•	½ tsp white pepper 	•	¼ tsp Worcestershire sauce 	•	3 green onions, finely chopped 	•	Square wonton wrappers 	•	Neutral oil for frying Yuzu Gochujang Crema  Ingredients 	•	375 mL Mexican crema 	•	1 tsp yuzu extract 	•	1–2 Korean chili peppers, chopped 	•	2 tbsp yuzu honey 	•	1 generous spoonful gochujang 	•	1 tbsp kewpie mayo

Recipe Name Caramel Cream Rice Krispie Treats Ingredients 1. 6 cups crispy rice cereal 2. 4 cups mini marshmallows 3. 4 tbsp unsalted butter 4. 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter 5. 1/2 cup caramel sauce 6. 1 cup white chocolate chips 7. 4 oz cream cheese, softened 8. 1/2 cup powdered sugar 9. 1 tsp vanilla extract 10. 1 cup heavy whipping cream 11. 1/4 cup caramel sauce, for drizzling 12. 1/2 cup crispy rice cereal, for topping Recipe 1. Line a 9×13-inch baking dish with parchment paper and lightly grease it. 2. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over low heat. 3. Add the mini marshmallows and stir continuously until completely melted and smooth. 4. Stir in the peanut butter until fully incorporated. 5. Remove the mixture from the heat and gently fold in the crispy rice cereal. 6. Press half of the cereal mixture firmly into the prepared dish to create an even base. 7. Melt the white chocolate chips gently in the microwave in short intervals, stirring between each interval. 8. Beat the softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth. 9. Whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold it into the cream cheese mixture. 10. Spread the cream mixture evenly over the first cereal layer. 11. Refrigerate for 15–20 minutes to help the creamy layer firm up. 12. Gently press the remaining cereal mixture over the cream layer without crushing it. 13. Warm the caramel sauce slightly and drizzle it generously over the top. 14. Sprinkle additional crispy rice cereal over the caramel. 15. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm enough to slice. 16. Lift the dessert from the pan using the parchment paper and cut into neat squares. 17. Drizzle each piece with extra caramel before serving for an extra rich finish. Follow this account for more irresistible no-fuss desserts and recipes you will want to make again.

Easy Pretzels 🥨 Ingredients * 300 g flour (2⅓ cups) * 170 g water (¾ cup) * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tsp sugar * 1 tsp salt * 1 tbsp oil Instructions 1. Mix the water, yeast, and sugar, then add the flour, salt, and oil. Mix the dough, then coil fold multiple times. Cover and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Divide the dough into 4 pieces. Roll each piece into a long rope and shape into a pretzel. 3. Bring a pot of water to a boil and add 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp baking powder. Place each pretzel in the boiling water for a few seconds, then remove and place on a baking tray lined with parchment paper. 4. Brush with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse salt. 5. Bake in a preheated 450°F (230°C) oven for 20 minutes. #pretzels #bread #baking #homemade #pretzel

🥩 Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket 🍖 This Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket is slow-cooked until irresistibly tender, then finished with a rich, sticky barbecue glaze that caramelizes beautifully in the oven. Every slice is juicy, smoky, and packed with bold flavor, making it the perfect centerpiece for family dinners, weekend gatherings, or holiday meals. Ingredients For the Brisket • 4–5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp garlic powder • 2 tsp onion powder • 1½ tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chili powder • ½ tsp ground cumin For the Roasting Base • 1 large onion, sliced • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup beef broth • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce For the BBQ Glaze • 1½ cups barbecue sauce, divided • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Arrange the sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a large roasting pan or Dutch oven. 2. Pat the brisket dry with paper towels, then rub it all over with olive oil. 3. In a small bowl, combine the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, chili powder, and cumin. Rub the seasoning mixture evenly over every side of the brisket. 4. Place the brisket fat-side up on top of the onions. Pour the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce around the meat. 5. Cover the pan tightly with a lid or heavy-duty aluminum foil and roast for 4½–5 hours, or until the brisket is fork-tender. 6. In a bowl, whisk together 1 cup of the barbecue sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar. 7. Remove the brisket from the oven and generously brush the top with the barbecue glaze. 8. Increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C). Return the brisket to the oven uncovered and roast for another 10–15 minutes, until the glaze becomes glossy, caramelized, and slightly charred around the edges. 9. Transfer the brisket to a cutting board and let it rest for 20 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. 10. Drizzle the sliced brisket with the flavorful pan juices and serve with the remaining barbecue sauce. Serving Suggestions Serve with creamy mashed potatoes, baked beans, buttery cornbread, roasted corn on the cob, coleslaw, mac and cheese, or grilled vegetables for a classic Southern-style barbecue feast. Storage Store leftover brisket in an airtight container with a little extra barbecue sauce in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat gently in the oven or on the stovetop to keep the meat tender and juicy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 5 hours Total Time: 5 hours 35 minutes Servings: 8 Calories: Approximately 520 per serving #BBQBrisket #ComfortFood #EasyDinner #FamilyMeals #SlowRoasted

Recipe Name Chocolate Peanut Butter Oreo Icebox Dessert Ingredients 1. 24 Oreo cookies, finely crushed 2. 5 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 3. 1 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter 4. 8 ounces cream cheese, softened 5. 1 cup powdered sugar 6. 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 7. 1 1/2 cups heavy whipping cream, cold 8. 1/4 cup powdered sugar for whipped cream 9. 1 1/2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips 10. 3/4 cup heavy cream 11. 2 tablespoons creamy peanut butter 12. 1/4 cup crushed Oreo cookies for topping Recipe 1. Line a 9x9-inch baking pan with parchment paper, leaving some overhang for easy removal. 2. Crush the Oreo cookies into fine crumbs. 3. Mix the cookie crumbs with the melted butter until evenly moistened. 4. Press the mixture firmly into the bottom of the pan to create an even crust. 5. Refrigerate the crust for 15 minutes to firm it up. 6. Beat the softened cream cheese and peanut butter until smooth and creamy. 7. Add 1 cup powdered sugar and vanilla extract and beat until completely combined. 8. In a separate chilled bowl, whip 1 1/2 cups heavy cream with 1/4 cup powdered sugar until stiff peaks form. 9. Gently fold the whipped cream into the peanut butter mixture until light and fluffy. 10. Spread the peanut butter filling evenly over the chilled Oreo crust. 11. Smooth the surface with a spatula and refrigerate while preparing the chocolate topping. 12. Place the chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons peanut butter in a heatproof bowl. 13. Warm the 3/4 cup heavy cream until steaming but not boiling. 14. Pour the hot cream over the chocolate and let it sit for 2 minutes. 15. Stir slowly until the chocolate becomes glossy and completely smooth. 16. Pour the chocolate ganache over the peanut butter layer. 17. Spread the ganache evenly to the edges of the pan. 18. Sprinkle crushed Oreo cookies over the top. 19. Refrigerate for at least 4–6 hours, preferably overnight, until completely firm. 20. Use the parchment overhang to lift the dessert from the pan. 21. Slice with a warm, clean knife and serve chilled. Follow this account for more irresistible chocolate and peanut butter desserts you will want to make again.

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per serving: Protein: 44g Carbs: 73g Fat: 10g Calories: 589 Ingredients per 2 servings: Chicken: - 14 oz skinless, boneless, chicken thighs, raw - 1/2 tsp white pepper - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 1 tbsp minced ginger - 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 3/4 cup coarse potato starch - 1 egg (egg white only, no yolk) - 1 second spray cooking oil - 4 green onion Sauce: - 1/2 tbsp wasabi - 1/2 tbsp brown sugar - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tbsp water - 1/2 tbsp lemon juice How to make it yourself: 1. Slice your green onions into very thin long strips, and chop your chicken into 2-inch cubes. 2. In a bowl, add your chicken, white pepper, minced garlic, minced ginger, Shaoxing wine, only the whites of an egg (no yolk), and soy sauce and mix well and set aside. 3. On a plate, pour your coarse potato starch. Dip your marinated chicken nuggets until it is fully coated with potato starch. 4. Spray your air fryer with cooking oil, place your chicken coated with potato starch inside the air fryer, and spray it with a quick light coat of spray oil. 5. Cook in your air fryer at 390°F for 13-15 minutes, flipping halfway through or until crispy and golden brown 6. In a small bowl, mix together wasabi, brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, water, and lemon juice to make your sauce. 7. Once cooked and crispy, plate half your chicken nuggets, top off with half your thinky sliced green onions, and pour half your sauce on top and enjoy. 📩 Save this Air Fryer Pa Dak (Korean Frid Chicken) recipe to make for later and if you make it, post it and tag me in it! ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender. Crispy Beef Street Corn Tacos 🌽🔥 Ingredients: For the Tacos: -1 lb ground beef -1 packet taco seasoning -2–3 tbsp salsa -1–2 tsp chipotle adobo sauce (adjust to spice preference) -Small flour tortillas -Shredded cheese For the Street Corn Topping: -1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese -Splash of water (for blending) -1 to 1 1/2 tbsp light mayo -1 cup corn -1–2 jalapeños, finely diced -Chopped pickled red onion -2–3 tbsp cotija cheese -Fresh cilantro, chopped -Everything But The Elote seasoning -Juice of 1 lime For Finishing: -Hot honey -Lime wedges Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook until charred. Remove from heat and let cool. 2. For the Street Corn Mixture: Add cottage cheese and a splash of water to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bowl and mix in: -charred corn -mayo -diced jalapeños -pickled red onion -cotija -cilantro -lime juice -elote seasoning to taste Set aside. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease if needed. Stir in taco seasoning, salsa, and chipotle adobo sauce. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until it’s all absorbed.  4. Place flour tortillas on a baking sheet (spray with oil if needed). Add a layer of shredded cheese, spoon in taco meat, then top with more cheese. Fold each tortilla in half. Place a baking rack on top of the tacos to help keep them closed while baking. Spray with avocado oil.  5. Bake at 425°F for 10–15 minutes, or until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. 6. Top warm tacos with the street corn mixture. Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

videos.caption: Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Marry Me Chicken Tortellini is an easy and delicious dinner recipe the whole family loves!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts, sliced into cubes  1/2 cup of flour  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder  2 TBSP olive oil 2 TBSP butter 2 TBSP of minced garlic 1 cup of chicken broth 1 cup of heavy cream 1 cup of Parmesan cheese 1 tsp of red pepper flakes  1/2 tsp each of oregano and thyme  1/3 cup of chopped sun dried tomatoes 19 oz bag of frozen tortellini  INSTRUCTIONS Mix together flour, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. Dredge chicken breasts into the flour/seasoning mixture.   In a skillet heat olive oil and butter on medium heat. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes on each side until golden brown and it reaches 165 degrees.  Take the chicken out of the skillet and put aside.  Add minced garlic, sun dried tomatoes, and chicken broth to the skillet. Lower heat and add heavy cream and Parmesan cheese. Stir well.  Add the red pepper flakes, oregano, and thyme. Stir together well and let simmer until it starts to slightly thicken (this could take at least five minutes).  Add one bag of frozen tortellini, cover, and let cook for a few minutes. The tortellini will also help thicken the sauce. Once tortellini is tender add chicken back to the skillet and serve. Enjoy! *This is a little bit spicy with 1 tsp of red pepper flakes, for less heat use 1/4 tsp!  #dinner #chicken #recipes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Sauté the garlic until fragrant, then stir in the soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, red pepper flakes, and MSG (if using). Simmer until the sauce is glossy. 5. videos.caption: Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Lemon Chicken Just Got an Upgrade 🍋🧄 This is one of our favorite dinners to make during the week and it’s going to be yours too. Lemon Garlic Chicken with Cherry Tomatoes has a little bit of everything to please anyone. I think this one really takes lemon chicken to the next level with the chili pepper garlic and tomato for a quick one pan meal that just tastes good every single time. Ingredients: 1 lb Thinly sliced chicken breast filets 1 cup Cherry tomatoes (halved) 3 cloves Garlic (chopped) 1/4 cup White wine Juice of 1 lemon Flour Olive Oil Salt and Pepper Chili pepper Knob of butter Chopped parsley Directions:  1. Thinly slice chicken breast filets and toss in flour. 2. Sear the chicken in olive oil on both sides. 3. Season with salt and pepper. 4. Add in the white wine. 5. Once the alcohol cooks out, add in tomatoes, garlic, chili pepper, and the juice of 1 lemon. 6. Cook until the tomatoes start to wilt. 7. Finish it off with butter and parsley. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp
